Karthik / team —

Attached is a draft export of subprocessors (see attachment stub: redwood_subprocessors_20260209.csv). Highlights:

- Cloud infra: AWS (us-west-2, us-east-1) — primary compute and object storage.
- Model store & artifacts: S3 (us-west-2) — model artifacts are encrypted at rest, customer data not stored with model artifacts.
- Telemetry: Datadog (processing of anonymized metrics), New Relic (optional for some Dedicated customers, region: US).
- Support tools: Zendesk (ticketing, logs in Zendesk are redacted), Intercom (optional for hosted onboarding flows).
- Analytics: Looker (aggregated product analytics), Mixpanel (opt-in telemetry).
- Backups & DR: GCP snapshots for specific clusters (us-central1) — limited to metadata backups; no plaintext customer PII.
- CDNs: Fastly (edge cache) — does not persist customer payloads beyond TTLs.

Caveats and notes:
- A few vendors (notably Intercom for older customers) have contractual restrictions on sharing detailed logs. Grace, please confirm.
- Telemetry classifications: majority are anonymized/aggregated; where identifiable support logs exist, we marked them in the CSV.

Next steps: I can produce a redacted CSV for procurement and a short narrative for the SIG. I also started answers for the SIG sections that map to subprocessor management (Sections C3-C6). See quick status below:
- Asset inventory mapping: complete.
- Data flow diagrams (subprocessor touchpoints): draft in progress.
- Vendor risk assessments: majority complete; two pending vendor questionnaires (Intercom and Looker) estimated by EOD Tuesday.

Attachment(s): redwood_subprocessors_20260209.csv (CSV export stub)
